1. **MEDIUM — `result_summary.json` contains false raw-report metrics.** MAIN maximal balance/equity DD are recorded as `53.83`/`414.02`, while the report says `1,053.83`/`1,414.02`. Both cells report `symbols_count=0` instead of `1`, and several average/streak metrics are zero despite nonzero report values. This violates the exact-or-unknown reporting rule and makes the machine summary unsafe for downstream consumers. [Summary](D:/EA_LAB_CONTROL/worktrees/ct-b14-model1-control-20260910/factory/runs/b14_gridlog_model1_control_20260910/result_summary.json:21) · [raw MAIN report](D:/EA_LAB_CONTROL/worktrees/ct-b14-model1-control-20260910/factory/runs/b14_gridlog_model1_control_20260910/runtime/MAIN/report.htm:790) · [schema](D:/EA_LAB_CONTROL/worktrees/ct-b14-model1-control-20260910/docs/research/EA_REPORT_SCHEMA.md:10)

2. **MEDIUM — BWD participation and yearly machine evidence are incomplete/mislabeled.** The claimed `10/36` active months counts entry months only. The ledger has 11 deal-active months and 13 exposure-active months, including February 2021 and positions spanning April–May 2020. It also contains 25 independent L0 baskets versus 73 position tickets, but no basket count is reported. The CSV/JSON omit the explicit zero-activity 2022 row that the narrative includes. [Summary](D:/EA_LAB_CONTROL/worktrees/ct-b14-model1-control-20260910/factory/runs/b14_gridlog_model1_control_20260910/result_summary.json:277) · [year split](D:/EA_LAB_CONTROL/worktrees/ct-b14-model1-control-20260910/factory/runs/b14_gridlog_model1_control_20260910/year_split.csv:5) · [narrative](D:/EA_LAB_CONTROL/worktrees/ct-b14-model1-control-20260910/factory/runs/b14_gridlog_model1_control_20260910/B14_GRIDLOG_FIXED_CONTROL_RESULT.md:53)

3. **MEDIUM — the claimed R1 visual pack does not meet the graph standard.** None of the SVGs identifies the exact experiment/run source. Participation lacks the `/36` denominator; DD lacks `%` and the exact DD definition; the scatter lacks axes/scales; and the “heatmaps” are two generic bars rather than Symbol×TF views. [Ladder requirements](D:/EA_LAB_CONTROL/worktrees/ct-b14-model1-control-20260910/docs/research/EA_REPORT_LADDER.md:55) · [graph provenance rule](D:/EA_LAB_CONTROL/worktrees/ct-b14-model1-control-20260910/docs/research/EA_REPORT_LADDER.md:229) · [participation SVG](D:/EA_LAB_CONTROL/worktrees/ct-b14-model1-control-20260910/factory/runs/b14_gridlog_model1_control_20260910/visuals/participation_heatmap.svg:1)
